abilities.name: Divine Purpose
abilities.text:
Activate to instantly charge Yrel's next Basic Ability at no mana cost. Divine Purpose's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds if Stunned or Silenced while charging her skills.

Passive: Yrel's Basic Abilities charge up over 1.5 seconds, increasing in effectiveness, but reducing Yrel's Movement Speed by 25%.

abilities.name: Vindication
abilities.text:
Unleash holy energy around Yrel, dealing 48 damage to nearby enemies and healing her for 111.

Charging up this Ability increases its damage up to 160, and healing up to 370.

abilities.name: Righteous Hammer
abilities.text:
Swing Yrel's hammer, dealing 42 damage to enemies in front of her and knocking them away.

Charging up this Ability increases its knockback distance, and damage up to 140. Enemies hit at maximum charge are Stunned for 1 seconds.

abilities.name: Avenging Wrath
abilities.text:
Leap to a location, dealing 260 damage to enemies in an area and Slowing them by 60% for 1 second.

Charging up this Ability increases its range.

abilities.name: Ardent Defender
abilities.text: Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.

abilities.name: Sacred Ground
abilities.text: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

1.name: Light of Karabor
1.text: Increase Vindication's radius by 15%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Vindication's healing by 40%. If more than one Hero is hit, the bonus is increased to 80%.

1.name: Dauntless
1.text: Casting a Basic Ability grants Yrel 35 Physical Armor for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Maraad's Insight
1.text: After damaging an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack heals her for 160.

4.name: Aegis of Light
4.text: Upon landing, Avenging Wrath grants other nearby allied Heroes 40 Armor for 5 seconds.

4.name: Gift of the Naaru
4.text: Divine Purpose heals the lowest Health nearby allied Hero other than Yrel for 275.

4.name: Hand of Freedom
4.text: Grant an allied Hero 25% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and remove all Slows and Roots from them.

7.name: Righteous Momentum
7.text: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Yrel is no longer Slowed while Channeling Righteous Hammer, and instead this bonus is quadrupled.

7.name: Holy Avenger
7.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with Avenging Wrath at maximum charge deals 25% more damage and reduces its cooldown to 1 second.

7.name: Divine Steed
7.text: Mounting is instant and grants 60% Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds.

10.name: Ardent Defender
10.text: Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.

10.name: Sacred Ground
10.text: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

13.name: Aldor Peacekeeper
13.text: Enemy Heroes hit by Vindication at maximum charge deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.

13.name: Repentance
13.text: Increase Avenging Wrath's Slow by 25% and duration by 0.75 seconds.

13.name: Velen's Chosen
13.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability at maximum charge grants 7.5% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.

16.name: Templar's Verdict
16.text: Righteous Hammer reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 15 for 4 seconds and deals bonus damage equal to 6% of their maximum Health.

16.name: Divine Favor
16.text: Casting a Basic Ability reduces the cooldown of Divine Purpose by 2.5 seconds.

16.name: Holy Wrath
16.text: After casting a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack splashes for 35% increased damage around the target.

20.name: Word of Glory
20.text: Increase the amount that Yrel heals from damage received from 50% to 75%. Ardent Defender heals nearby allied Heroes for 100% of the healing received by Yrel.

20.name: Hallowed Ground
20.text: Casting Avenging Wrath while inside Sacred Ground moves Sacred Ground to Yrel's location upon landing.

20.name: Bubble Hearth
20.text: After 1 second, Yrel becomes Invulnerable and casts Hearthstone. Cannot be canceled.

20.name: Seraphim
20.text: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds.
